Card Q&A.a:
The DP is overwritten by the effect that activated afterward, therefore the card is treated as a Digimon with 3000 DP. The  gained from [BT13-020 ShineGreymon: Burst Mode]'s effect remains because it isn't overwritten by anything.

Card Q&A.q: What happens if this card's effect activates for my [Marcus Damon] that's treated as a 12000 DP Digimon with  due to [BT13-020 ShineGreymon: Burst Mode]'s effect?
If [Marcus Damon] is treated as a Digimon by this card's effect and then its DP is reduced to 0 by an effect, is it deleted?

Effect: [Main][Once Per Turn] For the turn, 1 of your [Marcus Damon]s is also treated as a 3000 DP Digimon and can't digivolve.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When any of your red or yellow Tamers suspend, you may delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
